07154 Qiryath Ba`al {keer-yath' bah'-al}

源自 07151 和 01168; 專有名詞 地名

AV - Kirjathbaal 2; 2

基列巴力 = "巴力的城"
1) 在猶大北方邊的城巿 且位於便雅憫西方和南方邊境上
   1a) 也是 '基列耶琳' 和 '巴拉'
record.edic_text:
07154 Qiryath Ba`al {keer-yath' bah'-al}

from 07151 and 01168;; n pr loc

AV - Kirjathbaal 2; 2

Kirjath-baal = "city of Baal"
1) a city on the northern boundary of Judah and on the western and
   southern boundaries of Benjamin
   1a) also 'Kirjath-jearim' and 'Baalah'
